Give your Ducati Panigale V2 a touch of style and comfort with our Comfort System seat cover.

Designed to provide a superior riding experience, the Comfort System by Tappezzeria Italia is an exclusive technology developed to enhance riding comfort and reduce fatigue for both rider and passenger, especially on long journeys.

Premium materials for performance and durability

The seat cover is designed to offer a perfect combination of style and durability, ensuring a more stable and safer ride in all conditions.

Tappezzeria Italia seat covers are made from high-quality 100% PVC marine-grade technical materials, printed with various textures such as carbon look, ultragrip, cordura, suede, leather, and more. Specifically designed for enhanced grip and style.

Available with or without Logo. Contact customer support for custom logos or embroidery.

Customizable inserts, available in different color variants to match your style:

• BL (black)

• RD (red)

✔ Waterproof* and weather-resistant, perfect for all seasons.
✔ UV-Treated Materials to keep colors vibrant over time and prevent wear.
✔ Double-stitched reinforced seams for greater durability and strength.
✔ High resistance to chemicals, such as gasoline, oils, and cleaners.

✔ Comfort System Technology:

  • High-density latex foam

The seat cover is paired with a special latex foam, providing extra cushioning. This material is known for its ability to absorb vibrations, evenly distributing the rider's weight on the seat. The result is reduced pressure on contact points, increasing comfort even during long journeys.

  • Better ergonomic support

Thanks to its composition, the Comfort System helps maintain a more natural and relaxed riding posture, reducing stress on the back and legs.

  • Greater durability compared to traditional padding

Traditional padding tends to compress over time, losing its effectiveness. The latex used in the Comfort System is highly resistant and maintains its elasticity for a long time, ensuring constant comfort.

  • Perfect for long journeys

This technology is specially designed for riders who cover long distances and need a seat that minimizes fatigue and provides optimal support.

Craftsmanship and maximum attention to detail

Each seat cover is handcrafted by skilled artisans using advanced stitching techniques and high-quality materials. The artisanal production ensures a perfect fit and impeccable finish, with carefully crafted details for maximum performance and a 100% Made in Italy style.

Installation

Comes with a detailed instruction manual for easy installation. However, for optimal results and a perfect fit, professional installation is recommended.

✔ Improves riding stability and safety thanks to anti-slip materials.
✔ Enhances comfort and reduces riding fatigue with integrated memory foam.

✔ Adds a sporty and modern look to your motorcycle with carefully crafted details.
✔ Provides protection and durability with waterproof and UV-resistant materials.
✔ Easy to install, with detailed instructions and professional installation option.

source_description_html:
Ride your Ducati and explore the world in complete safety wearing the Horizon V3 helmet designed by Drudi Performance. Boasting a distinct Ducati style, this modern and sleek helmet highlights the glossy carbon texture of the shell made from Ultra Carbon and aramid glass fibers. The heat-regulating, anti-static and dissipative Carbon Fitting padding is specifically designed to absorb and disperse kinetic energy in the event of impact, keeping the head cool and dry. The Eyewear Adaptive visor system allows you to comfortably wear your glasses, while the UltraWide visor with its extra large surface area provides excellent visibility and maximum driving safety. To complete the equipment, it has a sun visor with UV protection of the eyes of up to 400 nm, a chin guard with a mechanism to reduce the sail effect by maintaining the front section of the helmet in a raised position, and the special intercom insert. The new finish and color scheme of the new graphics give this touring helmet a neat yet edgy look. Whether it's a short weekend away or an adventure on the road, this helmet is everything you need to travel in complete safety and comfort, a travel companion you'll never want to leave behind.

Designed after the X-Lite X-1005, this helmet features an intermediate oval head shape.

 

Specifications:

 

Outside:

  • External shell in three sizes
  • Ultra Carbon external shell with high carbon content. A high carbon content is combined with aramid fiber and glass fiber

 

Inside:

  • Carbon Fitting internal padding. It is made from active carbon filaments with thermoregulating, anti-static and dissipative actions. The cap features an innovative mesh design, which increases the amount of air circulating around the top of the head, keeping it cool and dry.
  • Liner Positioning Control (LPC). A system that makes it possible to adjust the position of the liner and therefore change the actual layout of the inside of the helmet to suit all different anatomical requirements
  • Integrated cheek pads. The inner EPP foam padding of the cheek pads are designed to ensure perfectly equal pressure and consistent performance over time. They can be removed from their fabric covering to facilitate washing
  • Under-chin straps integrated within the cheek pads guarantee a perfect fit and noise damping. They are removable and washable
  • Eyewear Adaptive. Designed for those who wear glasses, provides space in the cheek pads for eyeglass temples

 

Visor:

  • Ultrawide Visor. The ultra-wide surface of the visor provides greater vision, also on each side, guaranteeing increased riding comfort whilst boosting active safety
  • Sun visor included providing up to 400 nm UV protection. Simple to remove for ease of maintenance and cleaning and adjustable to different positions. The patented activation system foresees an automatic return to standby position when not in use
  • The helmet is provided with pinlock

 

Additional Features:

  • Patented Dual Action chin guard opening system. Positioned at the strap's center, it allows opening with one hand
  • Quick release chin strap
  • Reflective panels
  • The helmet is equipped and approved to use the N-Com communication system for ease of installation of the same in the helmet

name: Tappezzeria Pistoia Special Color Comfort System Seat Cover for Ducati SuperSport
source_title: Tappezzeria Pistoia Special Color Comfort System Seat Cover for Ducati SuperSport
description: All the covers of Tappezzeria Italia, are made with 100% waterproof materials, the seams are heat-taped from the inside to prevent the infiltration of water,…
source_description_html:
All the covers of Tappezzeria Italia, are made with 100% waterproof materials, the seams are heat-taped from the inside to prevent the infiltration of water, ensuring 80% waterproofing.

However, infiltration may occur if the saddle is exposed to rain for a long time or to high pressure washing. These events, although rare, are not due to a defect in the coating.

All our saddles are made with a very elaborate graphic design, this in favor of an attractive aesthetic and great visual impact, our lines, now appreciated all over the world, are the maximum expression of made in Italy saddlery.

Master craftsmen sew our covers with great passion to give the customer a product that is recognizable and of great quality.

Unfortunately, the more numerous the seams in the coatings and the greater the possibility that small infiltrations will occur.

It is important to understand that if we realized covers with few seams (like some of our competitors) we could guarantee a total waterproofness of the saddle.

Anyway, Tappezzeria Italia put customer satisfaction first and so we decided to make small elastic and water-repellent covers that can be purchased separately from the saddle.

These protective covers (optional) are easy to adhere to the saddle and little bulky, if you find yourself having to leave the bike to the weather, just put the cover to be sure that your saddle will remain completely dry inside.

The protective covers will also be very useful both to protect your new saddle from water, and to protect it from the sun and from all those external factors that can ruin the saddle.

Each protective cover cost 20€ and can be purchased through our website or by sending an email to info@tappezzeriaitalia.it.

NOTE - THOSE ARE SEAT COVERS NOT THE WHOLE SEAT. YOU NEED TO PUT THOSE SEAT COVERS ON YOUR EXISTING SEATS.

source_description_html:
All the covers of Tappezzeria Italia, are made with 100% waterproof materials, the seams are heat-taped from the inside to prevent the infiltration of water, ensuring 80% waterproofing.

However, infiltration may occur if the saddle is exposed to rain for a long time or to high pressure washing. These events, although rare, are not due to a defect in the coating.

All our saddles are made with a very elaborate graphic design, this in favor of an attractive aesthetic and great visual impact, our lines, now appreciated all over the world, are the maximum expression of made in Italy saddlery.

Master craftsmen sew our covers with great passion to give the customer a product that is recognizable and of great quality.

Unfortunately, the more numerous the seams in the coatings and the greater the possibility that small infiltrations will occur.

It is important to understand that if we realized covers with few seams (like some of our competitors) we could guarantee a total waterproofness of the saddle.

Anyway, Tappezzeria Italia put customer satisfaction first and so we decided to make small elastic and water-repellent covers that can be purchased separately from the saddle.

These protective covers (optional) are easy to adhere to the saddle and little bulky, if you find yourself having to leave the bike to the weather, just put the cover to be sure that your saddle will remain completely dry inside.

The protective covers will also be very useful both to protect your new saddle from water, and to protect it from the sun and from all those external factors that can ruin the saddle.

Each protective cover cost 20€ and can be purchased through our website or by sending an email to info@tappezzeriaitalia.it.

NOTE - THOSE ARE SEAT COVERS NOT THE WHOLE SEAT. YOU NEED TO PUT THOSE SEAT COVERS ON YOUR EXISTING SEATS.

description: All the covers of Tappezzeria Italia, are made with 100% waterproof materials, the seams are heat-taped from the inside to prevent the infiltration of water,… Available in multiple sizes and/or colours — select your variant.
source_description_html:
All the covers of Tappezzeria Italia, are made with 100% waterproof materials, the seams are heat-taped from the inside to prevent the infiltration of water, ensuring 80% waterproofing.

However, infiltration may occur if the saddle is exposed to rain for a long time or to high pressure washing. These events, although rare, are not due to a defect in the coating.

All our saddles are made with a very elaborate graphic design, this in favor of an attractive aesthetic and great visual impact, our lines, now appreciated all over the world, are the maximum expression of made in Italy saddlery.

Master craftsmen sew our covers with great passion to give the customer a product that is recognizable and of great quality.

Unfortunately, the more numerous the seams in the coatings and the greater the possibility that small infiltrations will occur.

It is important to understand that if we realized covers with few seams (like some of our competitors) we could guarantee a total waterproofness of the saddle.

Anyway, Tappezzeria Italia put customer satisfaction first and so we decided to make small elastic and water-repellent covers that can be purchased separately from the saddle.

These protective covers (optional) are easy to adhere to the saddle and little bulky, if you find yourself having to leave the bike to the weather, just put the cover to be sure that your saddle will remain completely dry inside.

The protective covers will also be very useful both to protect your new saddle from water, and to protect it from the sun and from all those external factors that can ruin the saddle.

Each protective cover cost 20€ and can be purchased through our website or by sending an email to info@tappezzeriaitalia.it.

NOTE - THOSE ARE SEAT COVERS NOT THE WHOLE SEAT. YOU NEED TO PUT THOSE SEAT COVERS ON YOUR EXISTING SEATS.
